description: Heavy-query operations view backed by mssql_heavy_queries (active requests, 60s) and mssql_plan_cache_hotspots (historical CPU/duration/grant rankings, 5m).

panels.description: Non-background requests with elapsed >= 5s. This is the actionable count.

targets.expr: count(mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Active Sessions

panels.description: Suspended user/app sessions (often waiting on lock/IO/memory).

targets.expr: count(mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status="suspended"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Suspended

panels.description: Currently running (on CPU) heavy sessions.

targets.expr: count(mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status="running"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Currently running (on CPU) heavy sessions.

panels.description: Worst elapsed among non-background heavy sessions.

targets.expr: max(mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max Elapsed

panels.description: Worst CPU time among non-background heavy sessions.

targets.expr: max(mssql_requests_cpu_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max CPU

panels.description: Largest query memory grant (MB) among non-background sessions.

targets.expr: max(mssql_requests_granted_memory_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Max Grant

panels.description: Non-background sessions running longer than 2 minutes.

targets.expr: count(mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"} > 120000) or vector(0)

panels.title: Long > 2m

panels.description: Sessions on lock/IO/CPU/memory wait classes (not SLEEP/WAITFOR).

targets.expr: count(mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background", wait_type=~"LCK_|PAGEIOLATCH_|WRITELOG|ASYNC_NETWORK_IO|CXPACKET|CXCONSUMER|RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE|MEMORY_|SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD|OLEDB|PREEMPTIVE_|HTBUILD|HASH_OP|SORT_OP|IO_COMPLETION|BACKUPIO|BACKUPBUFFER"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Hot Waits

panels.description: Count of non-background heavy sessions per server over time.

targets.expr: count by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

panels.title: Active Sessions by Server

panels.description: Worst session elapsed per server.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

panels.title: Max Elapsed by Server

panels.description: Worst session CPU per server.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (mssql_requests_cpu_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

panels.title: Max CPU by Server

panels.description: Worst query memory grant (MB) per server.

targets.expr: max by (instance) (mssql_requests_granted_memory_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

panels.title: Max Memory Grant by Server

panels.description: Servers with the most non-background heavy sessions right now.

targets.expr: topk(15, count by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}))

panels.title: Top Servers - Active Sessions

panels.description: Which wait classes dominate current heavy sessions.

targets.expr: topk(15, count by (wait_type) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}))

panels.title: Top Wait Types (sessions)

panels.description: Databases with the most heavy sessions.

targets.expr: topk(15, count by (db) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}))

panels.title: Top Databases (sessions)

panels.description: Start here for fleet triage. Background = system workers (usually noise from this collector).

targets.expr: count by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})
count by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status="suspended"})
max by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})
max by (instance) (mssql_requests_cpu_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})
max by (instance) (mssql_requests_granted_memory_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

count by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background", wait_type=~"LCK_|PAGEIOLATCH_|WRITELOG|ASYNC_NETWORK_IO|CXPACKET|CXCONSUMER|RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE|MEMORY_|SOS_SCHEDULER_YIELD|OLEDB|PREEMPTIVE_|HTBUILD|HASH_OP|SORT_OP|IO_COMPLETION|BACKUPIO|BACKUPBUFFER"})
count by (instance) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status="background"})

panels.title: Servers - sessions / elapsed / CPU / grant / noise

panels.description: Top 40 non-background requests by elapsed. Click Statement cell to inspect full snippet.

targets.expr: topk(40, max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, client_host, program_name, status, wait_type, command, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}))

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, client_host, program_name, status, wait_type, command, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_requests_cpu_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, client_host, program_name, status, wait_type, command, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_requests_granted_memory_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, client_host, program_name, status, wait_type, command, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_requests_logical_reads{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, client_host, program_name, status, wait_type, command, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_requests_cpu_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

max by (instance, session_id, db, login_name, client_host, program_name, status, wait_type, command, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_requests_granted_memory_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"})

panels.title: Hot Wait Sessions (LCK_ / PAGEIOLATCH_ / RESOURCE_SEMAPHORE / ...)

panels.description: Heavy sessions grouped by wait_type.

panels.title: By Wait Type

panels.description: Heavy sessions grouped by database.

targets.expr: topk(30, count by (instance, db) (mssql_requests_elapsed_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}", status!~"background"}))

panels.title: By Database

panels.description: Client programs generating heavy sessions.

panels.description: Logins generating heavy sessions.

max by (instance, db, obj, query_hash, statement_snip) (mssql_top_query_avg_duration_ms{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"${instance:regex}", db=~"${db:regex}"})
